editorial.blurb: A refined French-American bistro with exceptional cocktails and elegant cuisine, complete with live piano accompaniment.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the mezcal cocktails (try both the sour and bitter versions) and request them made by Alex for expert mixology; arrive early on weekends to avoid crowds and ensure attentive service.
signatureDishes: Steak frites with caramelized onion sauce
Salmon in sweet bread with croissant texture
